ache.title: “Pull priorities” at version 1.0? Oh, Nero
ache.note: Wuthering Waves was at version 1.0 and past-Nero was already ranking who to pull: Jiyan or Yinlin. A game barely out, and the advice is about spending order. That’s the loop starting early, which is why this one carries the “Inside the Loop” label. The only real priority at launch is finding out if you even like the game.
watch: pull advice before you know the game
two limited banners to pick from
ache.tip: Play a new game for a couple of weeks before pulling on anything. If you still love it then, decide calmly.
lines: day one and already a shopping order. classic Nero
the game is new. your wallet isn’t
play first. pull maybe. maybe never
